title: Split PagesAndChatTests into focused fixtures
description:
Problem: PagesAndChatTests.cs is a large mixed-domain test fixture that slows triage and increases change risk.

Desired outcome: improve test maintainability and diagnosis speed by splitting into focused suites with shared builders/utilities.

Scope:
- In scope: move page service tests, chat tests, and controller behavior tests into dedicated fixtures; add shared helpers for setup reuse.
- Out of scope: changing asserted behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- No single replacement fixture becomes a new monolith.
- Coverage parity is maintained for migrated tests.
- Test intent and ownership are clearer from fixture names and file layout.

Validation:
- Run migrated test suites and compare pass/fail parity with previous baseline.
